designNotes.scope: Compact Hex Vector at the global 200-pixel device height. General modulation belongs to the Hex host.
designNotes.oscillators: Four compact oscillators with ratio, frequency offset, level/modulation depth and independent keytrack sliders. Keytrack examples are 100%, 100%, 50% and 0%.
designNotes.keytrack: Slim vertical keytrack sliders have no numeric readout. Colored fill grows upward from the bottom of each inset channel.
designNotes.oscillatorSwitches: Oscillator on/off buttons are one third of their previous width, have no visible label and use their full oscillator color when enabled.
designNotes.oscillatorControls: Compact ratio and frequency-offset fields fill left to right. Smaller level knobs use Hex’s dark face, thin blue arc and light pointer, with level readouts beside them. Fill amounts are illustrative previews.
